scope: Reclose the declared current CPU foundation using CYL0-6, affected public models and explicit inputs; retain inherited scientific scopes and failures. No automatic REL4 or complete release claim.

contracts.angular_momentum: J=sum(mom_w*W); boundary/body torque balance original1e-12, zero denominator exact zero
contracts.O7: Active missing/invalid input rejects; 25 registered auxiliary defaults and named auto remain traceable. Get second argument is audit metadata.

source.production_delta: Only GravityBox and SNIaCoupled: use ordinary 3D PointCoords profile for native meridian, require physical centres and reject transverse centre. Other charts keep original formulas/order.
source.test_delta: Two aggregate model checks in the existing full-preview contract; no new target or long CI family.

CPU_CTests.note: Seven completed passed bodies in a failed outer fixture window; corrected full preview passed separately. The failed outer batch is never relabelled PASS.

new_native_models.scope: Initializer short integration, not new long-term stellar or replacement CYL endpoint qualification

reuse_boundaries: CYL0-6 retains original source/ELF/input scope. Unchanged shared math and device owners reuse original checks; this is not new CUDA execution.
Old native uniform GBox inputs missing center_z lose current exact-input qualification; current CPU checks and derived input proof supplement only bounded uniform math.
The old RZ implementation and long trajectories remain historical; no identity transfer to cylindrical-rz-pwc.
General old REL3 evidence is reused by accepted source/active-path identity, not by counting registered models or assuming all changed sources are equivalent.

limitations.scope: Small high-pressure near-zero raw momentum fixture; rphi same-order control also fails. Scaled positive cases do not qualify original input.
Original main repeated-AMR FAIL and thermal GAP stay; only originally allowed L2 supplement and accepted short fresh scopes inherited. Not moved into REL4.
Existing f203 CUDA ELF predates two Host initializer repairs; rebuild those CPPs plus BuildIdentity/link, then necessary nonuniform native field parity. 65 GPU derived inputs prepared only.
Full release device/public integration, required original RT/Cellular parity, hostedCI/actionlint, packaging and GUI/platform remain separate.

failure_dispositions.initializer-acceptance4: Temporary Helm path and wrapped error-envelope fixture issues; no extra production change or threshold relaxation.
failure_dispositions.cpu-contracts5: Seven test bodies passed; preview Setup errors use existing exit5, typed missing configuration exit3. Corrected preview passes in window6.
failure_dispositions.affected-model-shorts7: Five retained processes completed. Private native reached same4e-14 in1step because dt_init is not a hard Hydro cap; new distinct dt_max input realizes4steps/midpoint at same endpoint.
failure_dispositions.final-api-ownership9: Invalid private rphi angular interval rejected correctly by old/new; corrected full2pi periodic fixture passed window10.
failure_dispositions.uniform-admission11: 65API inputs passed and first physical rejection correct; observer expected wrong wording. One completed rejection reused with old timing, not rerun.
failure_dispositions.prepared_public_binding: Earlier pre-correction public binding never executed; only final distinct frozen binding qualifies.
failure_dispositions.helper_raw_status_placeholders: run_one initializes conservative status FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE_NOT_PASS; root acceptance fields, exit, stdout/hash and comparator decide scientific result. Original raw status is never rewritten.
